newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,327 to dollar for October 28 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,327 to dollar for October 28 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,327 to the dollar for October 28.
This reference rate was set on Thursday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Wednesday for October 25 to 27 is 3,332 to the dollar, unchanged from Thursday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
